subject: Vaping and Youth Substance Use
overview: The Medford School Committee approved a shared city-school director of security position and an application for a MassDOT Safe Routes to School grant for Roberts Elementary. The committee also heard presentations on youth vaping and cannabis impacts, reviewed municipal prevention initiatives, and discussed the FY 2019 mid-year budget.

items.title: Routine Business and Secretary's Report
items.summary: Approved the minutes of December 17, 2018, along with bills, fund transfers, payrolls, and the secretary's report detailing high school heating repairs.

items.title: Roberts Elementary MassDOT Safe Routes to School Application
items.summary: Approved a letter of support for a MassDOT Safe Routes to School grant application seeking up to $1 million for pedestrian safety improvements near the Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: Superintendent's Update and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented updates on student service projects, instructional partnerships with Lesley University, facilities repairs, and high school vocational initiatives.

items.title: Donation Acceptance from Leaders Environmental
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of a $125 donation for educational purposes from Leaders Environmental.

items.title: Joint City-School Director of Security Position
items.summary: Approved adopting MGL Chapter 71, Section 37M to establish a shared city-school director of security position to oversee municipal and school facilities.

items.title: Informational Reports on Vaping and Cannabis Response
items.summary: Dr. Randy Schuster presented on the cognitive impacts of adolescent cannabis and nicotine use, followed by Board of Health and school staff updates on local regulations, prevention surveys, and health education efforts.

items.title: FY 2019 Budget Update
items.summary: Director of Finance Kirsteen Patterson reviewed the mid-year budget status, reporting that 52.2% of the $58.6 million general fund appropriation had been expended or encumbered.

items.title: Condolence Resolution for John Welch
items.summary: Adopted a resolution of condolence to the family of longtime educator and rink manager John Welch.
